note: MelloUI's colour palettes, the one source the tools read (Tools/kit_palette.py and what uses it). The same colours as MelloUI.Palettes in Core/Core.lua: Ember is the palette MelloUI shipped with (the default), the six others come from MelloUI-BuildData/palette/additions_0.14.0/palettes_0.14.0.json. Each id's kit is Media/Kit<Id> (Id = the id with its first letter in capitals) and its Game Menu picture Media/Textures/GameMenuFrame_<id>; Ember keeps its two looks, Media/KitWarm and Media/KitBronze, and GameMenuFrame_warm / _bronze. A palette with "looks": "ember" (Ember Vibrant, 0.19.1) has Ember's two looks too, made from its own roles by Ember's formulas: its warm iron in Media/Kit<Id>, its bronze in Media/Kit<Id>Bronze, GameMenuFrame_<id> / _<id>Bronze. A palette with "art" would have a kit painted for it (not recoloured from Media/Kit), written by Tools/build_art_look.py; none has since Forged Steel was taken out (user, 2026-10-04). Roles: the ten swatches, #RRGGBB.

ember.name: Ember
ember.blurb: MelloUI's first palette: warm dark brown, bronze-gold trim, a deep red for the selection.

emberVibrant.name: Ember Vibrant
emberVibrant.blurb: Ember, lit: ember-black panels, vivid bronze trim, bright cream-gold text, a jewel ember red for the selection.

obsidian.name: Obsidian
obsidian.blurb: Neutral black glass and pewter, cold white text, one crimson accent. The calmest, highest-contrast base.

obsidianVibrant.name: Obsidian Vibrant
obsidianVibrant.blurb: Black glass, deeper and crisper: blued-steel trim, silver titles, ice-white text, a jewel crimson for the selection.

royalAzure.name: Royal Azure
royalAzure.blurb: Throne room: deep navy, polished gold trim, cream text, royal blue selection.

royalAzureVibrant.name: Royal Azure Vibrant
royalAzureVibrant.blurb: Throne room, lit: deep sapphire navy, polished gold trim, crisp cream text, a jewel-blue royal selection.

felEmber.name: Fel Ember
felEmber.blurb: Fel and void: charred black, fel-green trim and titles, void purple for the selection.

felEmberVibrant.name: Fel Ember Vibrant
felEmberVibrant.blurb: Fel and void, stronger: ember-charred black, vivid fel-green trim and titles, deep void purple for the selection.
